nodes.label: Home fabrication (toner transfer, FeCl3, no plated holes)
nodes.norm_label: home fabrication (toner transfer, fecl3, no plated holes)
nodes.rationale: Double-sided without plated through holes, hand vias with resistor leg, no solder mask or silkscreen; drives THT soldering side, 1.3/0.7 mm vias, GND planes with 0.5 mm clearance.

nodes.label: Mains (HV) zone with reinforced isolation
nodes.rationale: 6 mm clearance/creepage to low voltage, 3 mm to edge, 7.5 mm to M3 holes (IEC 61010-1 / 60664-1, 300 V CAT II); ZMPT101B is the only isolation barrier; no solder mask so same figure in air and surface.

nodes.norm_label: bom decisions to review (electrolytics, 100 ohm 0.1%, leftovers)

nodes.label: Digital PCB routing strategy
nodes.rationale: 2x7 pinout is fixed by the analog board and a top-mounted THT cannot be mirrored, so all four connectors share the same order; CS lines jump layers instead of peak lines because peaks carry input capacitors.

nodes.label: Schematic changes for digital PCB (pin swaps, 1206)
nodes.norm_label: schematic changes for digital pcb (pin swaps, 1206)

nodes.label: Trace bridges under pads (1206 resistors, 0805 caps)
nodes.norm_label: trace bridges under pads (1206 resistors, 0805 caps)
nodes.rationale: On a mask-less board tracks pass between component pads; smaller sizes leave no room, so resistors are 1206; cover track with varnish/kapton before soldering.

nodes.label: Digital PCB vias (40) and GND islands
nodes.norm_label: digital pcb vias (40) and gnd islands

nodes.label: MCP23017 I2C expander U1 (chip selects)
nodes.rationale: Generates 10 chip selects without using RP2350B pins; CS pull-ups of 10k keep devices deselected until firmware configures the expander.

nodes.label: MCP3204 peak ADCs U2/U3
nodes.rationale: Each ADC reads two neighbouring lines to save routing crossings; VREF 3.3 V ratiometric with VBIAS.

nodes.label: Power consumption estimate (3.3 V ~4 mA, 5 V ~45 mA)
nodes.norm_label: power consumption estimate (3.3 v ~4 ma, 5 v ~45 ma)

nodes.label: 33 ohm series resistors on SCK/MOSI (R1-R8)
nodes.rationale: Ribbon cable is an unterminated short transmission line; series resistance damps ringing that could cause an extra clock pulse in MCP41010 and isolates lines from shorts.

nodes.label: BAT54S ADC protection replaces Zener BZV55C3V3
nodes.norm_label: bat54s adc protection replaces zener bzv55c3v3
nodes.rationale: Zener soft knee clipped up to 12% of the fundamental; Schottky pair stays reverse-biased within signal range.

nodes.label: Current channel (SCT-013, LM358 gain stage, MFB lowpass)
nodes.norm_label: current channel (sct-013, lm358 gain stage, mfb lowpass)

nodes.label: Single VBIAS buffer shared by both channels
nodes.norm_label: single vbias buffer shared by both channels
nodes.rationale: Direct follower (R4 = 0 ohm, C26 DNP) removes V to I crosstalk that a 47 ohm + 1 uF output created as in-phase power error; stability cannot be verified with the single-pole model and must be checked on the scope.
